The planet now matches the brand kit. Three things changed, plus one discovery along the way:

**What I changed:**
- **[planet.js](src/planet.js)** — replaced the gold metal continents with a smooth brand-purple surface: deep navy-purple sea (#1A1B3E → #534AB7) with land as a barely-brighter purple patch, uniform matte roughness, and much subtler polar frost. The landing island still works exactly as before — the pin and teal hover outline mark it, so it never needed to be gold.
- **[ring.js](src/ring.js)** — swapped the busy multi-band Saturn ring for the mockup's quiet treatment: one faint translucent purple fill with a single thin brighter line near the outer edge, and a slightly narrower span.
- **[planetView.js](src/planetView.js)** — moved the key light to the upper-left (matching the mockup's highlight position), cooled it to white-lavender, lowered its intensity so the orb stays deep and dark toward the limb, softened the atmosphere glow, and turned the cloud layer off since the mockup planet is clean.

**The discovery:** most of the "dirty marbling" I was chasing on the planet turned out not to be the planet at all — it's the CRT-TV overlay's screen-grime texture that sits over the whole page. With the TV effect off (it's toggleable under OPTIONS → DISPLAY), the planet is a perfectly clean purple orb. Since the CRT frame is a deliberate part of the booth look, I left it as is — but if you want the brand-kit crispness to come through more, I can dial down just the grime/smudge layer of the TV effect while keeping the scanlines.

Verified in the browser: splash and orbit view both show the smooth deep-purple planet with the thin ring, and the console is clean.

Much better — everything on the splash now reads clearly. What I changed, all in [style.css](src/style.css):

- **"ENTIRE.IO PRESENTS"** — 11px → ~14–18px (scales with screen width), bold, with a dark text-shadow so it holds up over the planet.

- **START MISSION / LEADERBOARD buttons** — up to ~15–19px / ~14–18px with bigger padding, and the ghost button is now bold like the primary.
- **OPTIONS** — 11px muted → ~13–16px bold at a brighter gray.
- **Scanline footer** — 9px → ~11–14px and less faded, since at 9px it was pure noise.
